title: Hound MCP
description: Dependency security scanner for AI coding agents
problem: AI coding agents lack awareness of supply chain security — they install packages without checking vulnerabilities, licenses, or typosquatting risks.
solution: Built an open-source MCP server that scans packages for vulnerabilities, checks licenses, inspects dependency trees, and detects typosquatting — with zero API keys and zero config.
result: AI agents can now make informed decisions about dependencies, catching security issues before they enter the codebase.

title: DineCard
problem: Restaurants needed a fast, modern digital menu that could update in real-time without reprinting physical menus.
solution: Built an AI-powered digital menu platform with QR code access, real-time updates, and menu item recommendations.
result: Restaurants can update menus instantly, reduce printing costs, and improve customer ordering experience.

title: Prempushp
problem: A family food brand needed a professional online presence with a product catalog to reach customers beyond word-of-mouth.
solution: Built a full product catalog website with clean design, fast load times, and easy navigation for the brand's range of products.
result: The brand now has a professional digital storefront that drives customer inquiries and builds trust with new buyers.

title: Prempushp Admin
description: Admin dashboard for Prempushp to manage products and communications
problem: Managing product listings and customer communications was done manually across spreadsheets and WhatsApp.
solution: Built a custom admin dashboard to manage products, track orders, and handle customer communications in one place.
result: Reduced time spent on manual updates, fewer errors, and a single source of truth for the business.
